fieldValues.title: An accepted domain estimate is a suggested problem
fieldValues.decision_question: How is an accepted domain estimate for a request recorded?
fieldValues.context: D7 of clerk#57 (plans/wg-srs-operations.md, section 8), asked of the owner since 2026-10-12. Recorded as a proposed decision on 2026-10-16 so a session can take it: until now it existed only as PR text, which no session agenda reads.
fieldValues.decision_statement: We model an accepted domain estimate as a suggested problem `held-by` a persona-in-domain, because a domain is derived, never stored.
fieldValues.rationale: A domain is derived through held-by and in-domain, never stored twice.
fieldValues.revisit_when: A request is accepted that no persona holds.
